privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what Nomad.now collects, why, and the control you have over it. It's written in plain language and isn't a substitute for legal advice.

sections.p: Account: the email address you sign in with (we use passwordless magic links, so we don't store a password). Profile content: everything you put on your card — handle, name, role, bio, links, cities, travel history, and any photos you upload. Payments: if you subscribe, Stripe returns customer and subscription identifiers we store to manage your plan; your full card number is handled by Stripe and never reaches our servers.

We run our own privacy-preserving analytics — page views and link clicks on your card. Visitors are counted using a daily-rotated, salted hash rather than a persistent identifier, so we can't track anyone across sites or over time. We don't use advertising cookies, tracking pixels, or third-party analytics SDKs.

To render and serve your public card, operate your account and sign-in, process subscriptions, show you aggregate analytics for your own card, and detect and prevent abuse (spam, phishing, impersonation). We do not sell your data or share it for advertising.
We set only the essential cookies needed to keep you signed in. There are no advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

We rely on a small number of processors to run the service: Stripe (payment processing), Supabase (database, authentication, and file storage), and our hosting/CDN provider. They process data only to provide these functions. We may also disclose information where required by law.
By design, your card and everything on it is published at your public URL. Please don't put anything on it you wouldn't want to be publicly visible.

We keep your data for as long as your account exists. You can export everything (profile, links, visited countries) as JSON from your account tab at any time. Canceling a paid plan doesn't delete anything — your card reverts to the free tier and stays live. Deleting your account removes your card and makes the underlying data eligible for deletion.

You can access and export your data, correct it by editing your card, and delete it by deleting your account. Depending on where you live (e.g. under GDPR or CCPA), you may have additional rights; email us to exercise them.
Nomad.now serves a global audience, and your data may be processed in countries other than your own. Where required, we rely on our providers' standard safeguards for such transfers.
Nomad.now is not intended for anyone under 16, and we don't knowingly collect data from them.
If we update this policy, we'll change the date at the top of this page and, for material changes, take reasonable steps to let you know.

terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of Nomad.now. By creating a card or using the service, you agree to them. They're written in plain language and aren't a substitute for legal advice.

sections.p: You're responsible for activity on your account and for keeping access to your sign-in email. Your handle (nomad.now/yourname) is reserved for you while your account exists, but you don't own it — we may reclaim handles that impersonate others, are reserved for system use, or infringe someone's rights.

Don't impersonate other people or brands, post illegal content, distribute malware or phishing links, spam, scrape the service, or attempt to break, overload, or circumvent it. We may suspend or remove cards that violate this.

You keep ownership of everything you put on your card. You grant us the limited license needed to host, display, and share your card so the service can function. You're responsible for having the rights to the content you upload, including any images.

Every card is free to create and stays live on its direct link with a small "Made with Nomad.now" footer. Paid plans add discovery (search indexing and the /map and /in directory), remove the footer, and unlock customization and deeper analytics. Feature availability may change as the product evolves.

Paid plans are billed on a recurring basis (monthly or yearly) through Stripe until canceled. Prices are shown at checkout and may change with advance notice; taxes may apply depending on your location.

You can cancel any time from your account. Paid features remain active until the end of the current billing period; after that your card reverts to the free tier and stays live. Payments are generally non-refundable except where required by law.
We may suspend or remove cards that break these Terms, and we may discontinue the service. You can delete your account at any time. Suspended or moderated cards stop rendering publicly.
The service is provided "as is" and "as available," without warranties of any kind. We don't guarantee it will be uninterrupted, error-free, or that it will meet your specific needs.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, Nomad.now is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, and our total liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months before the claim.

We may update these Terms; we'll change the date at the top of this page and, for material changes, take reasonable steps to notify you. Continuing to use the service after changes take effect means you accept them.

feature1.label: Travel
feature1.title: The map that grows with you.
feature1.body: Not a row of flag emojis. A real constellation — visible at a glance, sharable as an image, and yours forever as you keep moving.

feature2.label: Time
feature2.title: Wherever you are, your clock follows.
feature2.body: Your local time refreshes every minute on your card. Collaborators on the other side of the world stop wondering when you're reachable.

feature3.label: Status
feature3.title: Tell people what you're up to.
feature3.body: Pick a preset like freelancing or full-time, or write your own. Visible above the fold, never out of date.

feature4.label: Get hired
feature4.title: Land work while you travel.
feature4.body: A solid "Hire me" button and a softer "Grab a coffee" pair, right under your name. Most freelancers' link-in-bio is a landing page in disguise — your card just says so out loud.
feature4.caption: Pair the primary hire path with a peer-meetup CTA. Either, both, or neither.

feature5.label: Always now
feature5.title: A card that knows it's now.
feature5.body: One line for what you're working on, with a quiet "updated today" so people trust it's current. Go quiet and it gently fades — and a fresh card shows up first under Explore's "active now". The now in nomad.now, made real.
feature5.caption: Tap "I'm still here" to re-freshen. No upkeep, no stale card.

noFree.a: Yes. Every card is free to create and stays live on its direct link, with a small Nomad.now footer. Paid plans add discovery (search + the /map and /in directory), remove the footer, and unlock customization. We never run ads or take transaction fees.

cancel.a: Yes. Paid features stay active until the end of the current billing period. After that your card simply reverts to the free tier — still live on its direct link, just unlisted and with the footer back. Nothing is deleted.

data.q: What happens to my data if I cancel?
data.a: Nothing is deleted. Canceling only reverts your card to the free tier — it stays live on its direct link. You can export everything (profile, links, visited countries) as JSON from your account tab at any time, and deleting your account removes the card for good.

switch.q: Can I switch between Basic and Pro?
switch.a: Upgrade anytime — billed prorated. Downgrade takes effect at the end of the current period.

fees.a: No. We don't sell digital products on your behalf, so there's nothing to take a cut from. The card is your card.
